descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S13 Held row across processing: refreshed by each processing, deleted 36 h after the last one

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Hospital held and stopped medication rows are deleted at 36 h, and a held row's clock restarts each time the chart is processed: a held row not refreshed for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: held/stopped med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden … (UAT OAT-04; UAT OAT-04 step 2; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient with 'furosemide 40 mg, held for AKI' dictated at T0

When The chart is processed at T0+30 h (pre-round Save Note that does not mention furosemide); age to T0+37 h and purge; open the chart at T0+50 h without processing; age to T0+67 h and purge

Then At T0+37 h the row is present (refreshed at T0+30 h); opening the chart at T0+50 h does not refresh it; at T0+67 h the row is gone from the database

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 / OAT-04 (B) / TFA-94699 table ('refreshed each time the chart is processed'): present at T0+37 h and absent at T0+67 h = pass; gone at T0+37 h (too early) or present at T0+67 h = Fail. If Q19 says AC 2 also covers held rows (a processing without a new value does not refresh them), the T0+37 h expectation flips to absent; …

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.
